articles.title: Hormuz vessel transits fall to single digits
articles.summary: Hormuz vessel transits fall to single digits The number of vessel transiting the Strait of Hormuz fell to seven on Thursday from 11 the previous day, well below the 10-day average of 15, according to Reuters. Preliminary ship-tracking data showed on Friday that of the seven, two vessels exited and five entered, the report said. The figures exclude any vessels that might have crossed the strait with their Automatic Identification System transponders turned off to avoid detection.  The ship transits averaged 15 a day during the past 10 days. (AFP)
